No invoice, address or date of birth for the payee is on file to confirm or rule out that this is the listed person. Request the tradesperson's details.

why_not.CLOSE: Nothing on file distinguishes the payee from the listed person.
why_not.ESCALATE: A name-only match on a small trade payment is not enough to show it is the listed party.

sop_basis: TM01 >3x income; plausible one-off event needs documents
rationale: Hayden Wilworth received £44,488.67 from Hartcote Solicitors LLP client account ref 'ESTATE OF JORDAN TALCOTE' on 13 Sep 2026, 21 times income. An inheritance is plausible and the source is a solicitor, but no estate letter is on file. Request the solicitor's letter confirming the distribution.

why_not.CLOSE: No document confirms the inheritance.
why_not.ESCALATE: Funds from a solicitor client account with no onward movement are not suspicious.

doubts: A matching solicitor letter would make this CLOSE.

sop_basis: TM01; TM02 pass-through; documented loan funding an invoiced purchase
rationale: Casey Draycombe's £18,400.00 'LOAN ADVANCE' from Crancombe Finance Ltd on 18 Sep 2026 matches loan agreement LOA-9836 (purpose: used car). The £20,900.00 paid to Talfield Motors Ltd on 19 Sep matches dealer invoice INV 52765 (INV-2214) to the customer. The balance came from the customer's own funds.

why_not.ESCALATE: Amounts, parties and invoice number match; only a vehicle-detail inconsistency.
why_not.RFI: The loan agreement and invoice document both legs.

doubts: The invoice lists a 2022 model with a 21-plate registration (UY21), which is inconsistent. If that is treated as an invoice mismatch, it would be RFI or ESCALATE.

sop_basis: TM03 3+ cash deposits £9,000-£9,999.99 in 10 days; TM01 >2x turnover
rationale: Between 8 and 17 Oct 2026 Fernwick Trading Ltd made twelve cash deposits of £9,080-£9,925 at three locations, totalling £114,885.00. That exceeds its whole annual cash sales (£68,005 per ACC-7172) in ten days, against normal takings of about £2,600. Staff note NTE-4155 records the director asking whether staying under £10,000 avoids reporting and saying they would use a different branch. The earlier December-peak review does not cover October.

why_not.CLOSE: Records do not explain the volume, and the staff note shows intent to avoid thresholds.
why_not.RFI: Explicit threshold-avoidance remarks plus the pattern are clear structuring indicators.

sop_basis: TM02 80% out in 48h; own-account transfers below 5 times income close
rationale: Cameron Corton moved £8,225.00 in from their Meadowcroft Building Society account on 4 Oct 2026 and out to their Northgate Bank fixed-rate savings account on 5 Oct. Statements STM-7939 and STM-6450 show the customer holds both accounts and record the matching transfers. About 2.4 times income.

why_not.ESCALATE: Moving money between one's own accounts to savings is not suspicious.
why_not.RFI: Both accounts are documented as the customer's own.
